column1: # Exports of Ridom SeqSphere+ that replace kansasii-mst / kansasii-cgmlst (numbers as in kansasii-docs/docs/RIDOM.md).
# file     : name in data/imm/ ({subset} is replaced by each subset below)
# id_column: column with the Sample ID (empty = format not seen yet, only presence is checked; `labels` = the labels of a .meg matrix)
# cohort   : keep = isolates of the cohort without `excluded` (174); pool = also those excluded only by low coverage (M055, 175)
# refs     : yes = the 7 public GTDB references (GCF_*) must be in the file too
# subsets  : none = one file; else one file per subset of SUBSETS in common.py
